notes: Main accuracy uses parsed greedy generation on all conditions; score_accuracy separately uses first-position option argmax. Diagnostics tune gain on option scores.

K/U denotes observed original-action preference/non-selection, not proven parameter memory or knowledge absence; it is model-specific, defined by original closed-book parsed greedy answer in main; diagnostic strata use option scores. Invalid closed-book outputs are counted in U and explicitly flagged by parse_failure_rate.
A/C correctness, B original-action selection, C edited sibling misuse are separate metrics.
Source path labels define constructed counterfactuals; not independent clinical ground truth.
condition_annotation: AI research semantic classification by review_statistics agent, reviewed by main agent; not expert clinical ground truth
condition_label_status: Exploratory AI semantic labels when annotation file exists; otherwise keyword candidates. Not expert clinical ground truth.
